capabilities: show a copy button next to formatted text in editing and reading modes
copy content per type, preserving syntax like the # prefix on tags
enable or disable copy buttons per content type in settings
toggle all copy buttons on or off with a command
customize the button icon and copying notification
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. BRAT install is offered for testers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to copy a specific piece of formatted content like an inline code span, tag, or link with one click; users must select and copy manually.
summary: Copy-button plugin that places a click-to-copy button next to formatted text such as inline code, bold, highlights, tags, and links.
